extensionDescription.message: Sort bookmarks from one Inbox into folders you choose.

optionsIntroduction.message: Only bookmarks that land directly in your Inbox are sorted. Everything saved elsewhere stays untouched.

refreshFoldersButton.description: Button that reloads bookmark folder choices.

foldersRefreshedMessage.message: Folder choices updated. Your unsaved changes are preserved.

foldersRefreshError.message: Folder choices could not be refreshed. Your unsaved changes are still here.

inboxFolderHelp.message: Bookmarks created or moved directly here will be classified.

reviewFolderHelp.message: Uncertain or failed sorts land here.

processExistingLabel.message: Sort bookmarks already directly inside the Inbox when I save

confidenceThresholdHelp.message: Matches below this go to Needs review.

rulesDescription.message: Checked top to bottom; the first match wins. Drag ⠿ to reorder.

rulesEmpty.message: No rules yet. New Inbox bookmarks will go to Needs review.

reorderRuleLabel.message: Reorder rule $1. Drag, or press the up and down arrow keys.
reorderRuleLabel.description: Label for the drag handle that reorders a rule.

ruleMovedMessage.message: Rule moved to position $1. Save to apply it.

deleteRuleLabel.description: Accessible label for deleting a rule.

optionsLoadError.message: Nestmark could not load the bookmark tree. Reload this page and try again.

validationThresholdInvalid.message: Minimum confidence must be a whole number from 0 to 100.

validationFoldersMustDiffer.message: Inbox and Needs review must be different folders.

validationInboxMissing.message: The configured Inbox no longer exists.

validationReviewMissing.message: The configured Needs review folder no longer exists.

validationInboxUnwritable.message: The selected Inbox cannot be modified.

validationReviewUnwritable.message: The selected Needs review folder cannot be modified.

validationReviewInsideInbox.message: Needs review cannot be inside the Inbox.

validationRuleConfidenceInvalid.message: Confidence must be a whole number from 0 to 100.

validationRuleDestinationInsideInbox.message: The destination cannot be the Inbox or one of its subfolders.

validationRulePrefix.description: Prefixes a validation issue with a rule number.

composerHeading.description: Accessible label for the quick-add rule controls.

composerHint.message: Type a domain, URL wildcard, or title word, pick a folder, and press Enter. Pasting a full URL keeps only its domain.
composerHint.description: Help text under the quick-add rule controls.

unsavedChangesLabel.description: Indicator shown next to the save button when settings were edited.

folderOptionLabel.description: Folder choice label: folder name, then its parent breadcrumb path.

ruleMatchTypeRowLabel.description: Accessible label for a rule match type selector.

rulePatternRowLabel.description: Accessible label for a rule pattern input.

ruleConfidenceRowLabel.description: Accessible label for a rule confidence input.

ruleDestinationRowLabel.description: Accessible label for a rule destination selector.

patternPlaceholder_url_pattern.description: Pattern example for URL wildcard rules.

patternPlaceholder_title_keyword.description: Pattern example for title keyword rules.

ruleAddedMessage.message: Rule $1 added. Save to apply it.

rulePrefilledMessage.message: Choose a destination and press Enter to add this rule.
rulePrefilledMessage.description: Shown when settings open with a suggested rule.

settingsSaveError.message: Settings could not be saved. Your changes are still here.

setupRequiredMessage.message: Choose an Inbox and Needs review folder before Nestmark can sort bookmarks.

unknownFolderLabel.description: Fallback for an unavailable folder path.

reasonShortNoRule.description: Short activity label when no rule matched.

reasonShortBelowThreshold.description: Short activity label for a match under the confidence minimum.

reasonShortManualMove.description: Short activity label when a manual move cancelled sorting.

problem_inbox_missing.message: The configured Inbox is unavailable. Open settings and choose it again.

problem_review_missing.message: The Needs review folder is unavailable. Open settings and choose it again.

problem_destination_missing.message: A rule destination is unavailable. Review your rules.

problem_move_failed.message: The browser rejected a bookmark move.

problem_processing_failed.message: A bookmark could not be processed.

error_undo_stale.message: The bookmark moved again, so Nestmark left it alone.

popupLoadError.message: Nestmark could not load its activity.

createRuleButton.description: Popup button that opens settings with a rule suggested from the bookmark.
